title: Uniquely Tangy Irish Ground Pork Tagine
description: A tangy and indulgent Irish dish featuring ground pork cooked in a tagine on a salt block, perfect for a special occasion. This diabetic-friendly dish is a unique twist on traditional Irish cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the salt block in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the ground pork until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the prunes, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to the preheated salt block and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the salt block and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the uniquely tangy Irish ground pork tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
